strip_properties: The strip runs inside the receiver, on the decoded in-memory datapoint, before admission to the observation queue and therefore before any aggregation, counter-delta state, or grouping.
A stripped value is never written to disk, a log, a crash report, or a diagnostic capture, and never keys any local structure, cache, or metric.
A datapoint from which a stripped attribute cannot be removed is rejected whole. There is no partial-clean path.
The strip does not depend on any environment variable or vendor setting.
